name: sure-mail
description: A mail client whose entire logic lives in a headless core compiled to WASM, cleanly separated from every host

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-core && npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-host && npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-cli && npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-host-web && npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-ui
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-host-web && npm run build --workspace @shing.wong/sure-mail-ui
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && node --test test/*.test.mjs
